display_long_description:
Starvault is the first true VR MOBA shooter, blending classic MOBA strategy with explosive hero-shooter action. Squad up, master unique heroes, unlock insane skins, and jump into intense 5v5 battles. Step into the arena!


[media]
Different roles. Different mechanics. Find your main

[media]
Queue solo or team up with friends in 5v5 matches

[media]
Lanes, towers, abilities, jungle - all from a first-person VR view.

[media]
Customize, experiment, and relax in Sandbox

[media]
Every match plays out differently. Strategy matters.

**Always Evolving**

Regular updates, new heroes, and a friendly community.
